messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@avahealth.com>, Susan Park <susan.park@avahealth.com>
Date: Sun, 26 Jul 2026 01:03:00 +0000
Subject: Customer acceptance criteria, owners, and first-30-day commitments - Ava Health

Hi all —

Thanks again to the Ava team for signing; welcome aboard. This thread is to summarize the acceptance criteria from procurement, confirm internal owners, and list our first-30-day commitments so CS knows what to prioritize. High-level deal context below, then the commitments and open risks.

Deal context (quick):
- Account: Ava Health (pilot across 3 clinics, expected rollout to 20 in Q4).
- Contract: 12-month subscription + Dedicated capacity add-on; SOW attached (SOW_AvaHealth_v1.pdf).
- Primary contact: Tom Li (technical), Susan Park (ops/procurement).
- Go-live target: pilot ingestion + sample integrations by 2026-08-20.

Acceptance criteria (what procurement wants to sign off on):
1) Ingest sample EHR export (HL7 batch) into staging, mapping validated by Ava ops.
2) Response latency for 95th pct at pilot load <= 400ms for short prompts (expected sample load in SOW).
3) Audit log delivery to Ava S3 bucket with 30-day retention + KMS key exchange proof.
4) Basic RBAC for 5 users and single sign-on via SAML tested against Ava dev IdP.

First-30-day commitments (owner -> deliverable -> target date):
- Karthik Iyer (PS lead) -> Build ingestion pipeline + mapping; coordinate test export with Tom; target 2026-08-05.
- Marissa Cole (CS system owner) -> Stage configuration, KV cache policy, and perf baseline; target 2026-08-10.
- Tessa Morgan (deal lead) -> Coordinate contract/DocuSign + procurement redlines; confirm billing start; target 2026-07-30.

Open risks / asks for CS:
- Risk: Ava requires their own KMS for audit logs (we support but need KMS ARN and service account). Action: Marissa/Karthik to request ARN and confirm at first call.
- Risk: Integration team has custom HL7 fields; we may need a quick field-mapping sprint. Action: ask Tom for a sanitized sample export.

Attachments: SOW_AvaHealth_v1.pdf, Implementation_Checklist_Ava.xlsx (attached). Miro board for runbook linked below.

Next steps: Can the CS team confirm owners and whether the targets above look realistic? I can run the kickoff call Friday 2026-07-30 at 16:00 ET if that works for everyone.

Thanks,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0106 | tessa.morgan@redwood.com

Thanks Tessa — I agree with the owners. A few clarifying Qs before we commit to the dates: 

1) For perf baseline: do we have an estimate of the peak concurrent sessions during pilot (not just average TPS)? If they expect spikes, we should set the perf test accordingly.
2) For KMS: is Ava providing access to a test key (ARN) or do they expect Redwood to provision and hand over? This changes the runbook.
3) For SAML SSO: do they have a test IdP already or is that still with their security team?

I can take the 2026-08-10 target for perf if we get the HL7 sample and the env details by 2026-08-02. Can Karthik own the ingestion mapping work and drop a preliminary mapping doc into the Miro board?

Onwards —
Marissa

Marissa / Tessa —

I can take ingestion mapping. Tom, could you drop a small, sanitized HL7 export (one patient, one visit) into the Miro board or attach to an email? Preferably with the fields you absolutely need mapped so we don't over-index. Once I have that I will:
- Draft a field-mapping spreadsheet
- Propose a lightweight transform (lambda) to normalize the custom fields
- Run a local end-to-end ingest to staging and send perf traces (KV cache warm/cold)

Quick answers to Marissa's Qs:
- Peak concurrency: Ava indicated pilot expected 8 concurrent inference sessions during clinic hours and spikes to ~20 during bulk upload windows (per Tom's note in discovery). We'll use 20 as a conservative spike.
- KMS: Procurement wants us to integrate with Ava's KMS. Tom, please share the test ARN and the service account email for the S3 bucket so we can validate object encryption and key policy.
- SAML: Tom, confirm whether the dev IdP is available for testing or if the security team needs an access window.

I will populate the mapping doc on the Miro board by Wednesday 2026-07-28 EOD.

Thanks,
Karthik
